Reused device_session_actions as the authoritative Action Ledger and restored ASSESSED, EXECUTING, EXECUTED, VERIFIED and COMPLETED semantics; M6 tables hold only claims, permits and additive detail receipts.
Bound tx#2 to an existing running capability job whose run, session and device match the typed authorization.
Recomputed trusted parameter hashes from actual server-trusted parameters and rejected non-write primitives before any action claim or counter.
Closed live result schemas with valid JSON Schema types and exact effect accounting.
Made the inherited-pipe child binding exact, alias-01-only and explicitly closeable.
Added an independent effect-boundary oracle and kept legacy replay grounding byte-pinned and unreachable from live v2.
